fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 has no unrestricted affine-coset seed to tensor. Generation 3 certified only fixed-marginal local affine inconsistency, while Generation 5 showed that this property collapses under overlap (L); tensoring cannot repair the absent global syndrome, U, or P.

Proposal 2 is defeated by an exact affine selector relation. For a clause falsified by 000, the legal labels satisfy 100+010+001-110-101-011+111=000 with coefficient sum one; any linear large-digit check compatible with every honest choice and only global Boolean coefficients preserves this relation, so superincreasing weights cannot prevent the constant-support signed bypass (L/P).

Proposal 3 does not prevent a harmful selector from making the algebraic syndrome exactly zero, so S/L/P survive unchanged. Degree Theta(log N) with constant ideal norm yields only a sqrt(log N)-scale Minkowski lower bound; obtaining N^c by scaling the ideal is merely a weighted check, and the proposed unit cage is not specified as an unrestricted lattice mechanism (U/G).

Proposal 4 supplies neither an explicit high-systole complex nor an attachment map proving that every unsatisfied formula reaches a nontrivial class. A mapping cone can retain clause-supported cycles or turn the P witness into a boundary, so the proposed SNF experiment is not defined until the missing construction is supplied (L/P/G).

Proposal 5's search over integral Gram matrices is unbounded because no coefficient range is given. Even a finite shell success would establish neither a polynomial-size formula construction nor an N^c shell-ratio law, leaving X/G unresolved.

Proposal 6 offers only constant-distance expansion without a theorem separating propagated inconsistency cost from the replicated Boolean/selector completeness cost. Omitting anchors revives signed histories, while replicating anchors normally scales completeness with soundness; finite repetition data cannot establish polynomial amplification (S/L/P/G).

Proposal 7 assumes the missing polynomial-size compressed certificate action. Listing sufficient moments or monomials risks X, while degree-2 through degree-4 tests on two cores cannot discriminate whether general formulas admit polynomial certificate degree, height, or Euclidean separation (G).
evidence: Generation 1 verifies that freely adjustable integer directions can zero every amplified residual while paying only an unamplified anchor cost, establishing obstruction S for mechanisms that do not exclude exact-zero syndromes.

Generation 5 found squared-norm-at-most-4 kernel moves in every one- and two-variable overlap composition tested, across 5,832 systems and 95,256 references. This directly invalidates treating the Generation-3 local survivor as a composable tensor or clause gadget.

Generation 6's emitted lattice omitted normalization and consistency constraints, used changing-reference distances, retained exponentially listed assignment relations, and has an exact nine-clause mod-2 bypass. These are current U, T, X, and P blockers that none of the proposals resolves with a concrete basis and single target.

The supplied verifiers support only bounded local facts: 126 empty fixed-marginal fibers and norm-12 constrained quotient searches. They provide no unrestricted global coset, polynomial relation family, multiplicativity theorem, systolic attachment theorem, or dimension-dependent gap.

No experimental result is supplied for any of the seven proposals. Their proposed finite searches therefore cannot be credited as evidence, and several are not bounded or concretely specified enough to run.
